description: Hand-authored ground truth for a subset of fixtures/alerts. Each entry maps one synthetic alert id to critical, high, medium, low, or info. Synthetic demo data only — never real PII.
provenance: Written for this repository in T2. External addresses are RFC 5737 documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24). Names use RFC 2606 example domains. File hashes are repeated-nibble placeholders, not observed malware.
